objectives: "The aim of this course is to provide students general knowledge of multimedia databases. Particularly, indexing techniques including feature extraction and representation, image annotation and categorization, etc. are introduced. In addition, the concept of retrieval strategies, such as browsing, query by content, etc. is provided. Finally, applications and research trends for multimedia databases will be discussed."
content:
1  Course introduction
2  Introduction to multimedia databases
3  Information Retrieval
4  Image Retrieval
5  Techniques for multimedia database indexing I (Presentations)
6  Techniques for multimedia database indexing II (Presentations)
7  Relevance Feedback (Presentations)
8  Applications of multimedia databases I (Presentations)
9  Applications of multimedia databases II (Presentations)
10 Query strategies in multimedia databases (Presentations)
11 HCI in multimedia databases (Presentations)
12 Evaluation of multimedia retrieval systems (Presentations)
13 Applications of multimedia databases II (Presentations)
14 Research topics in multimedia databases I (Presentations)
15 Research topics in multimedia databases II (Presentations)
16 Research topics in multimedia databases III (Presentations)
